versions.content: Utilization of all neighboring egress queues with a resumed emission opportunity to approximantely 100 % Status: DRAFT Neighboring egress queues with EthCtrlConfigEgressQueueTransmission- SelectionAlgorithm set to ETH_TRANSMISSION_SELECTION_ETS shall equally share remaining available bandwidth on runtime. The sum of utilized bandwidth of all neighboring egress queues with a resumed emission oppertunity should result • in the amount of Ethernet frames covered by one emission portion if available bandwidth is configured in weights as amount of Ethernet frames • in approximately 100 % if available bandwidth is configured in percent
